about_the_game:
Create a peaceful garden. Build a soothing retreat and help the wandering creatures unwind from chaotic lives. Misty Garden is a calm and relaxing base building providing laid-back experience interacting with the Purrlings, a creature living in the Misty forest.

Take care of Purrlings!

  • They are interested in your garden! Welcome and place them in the facilities for them to relax. There are open-air rock baths, hot-sand spa, and places to take a nap!

Build & Decorate facilities for the Purrlings to relax

  • Build and upgrade the facilities the Purrling could use during their stay. They might even request a specific service from you! Decorate the place well, so it looks nice and cozy!
